text:
Kim S: RC promotion paused — pipeline-4 smoke failing 5/5 on staging, blocking the cut.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for run 2026-03-23T14:55Z — failing checks: smoke (pipeline-4). Reason: testdb seed timeout. See logs: https://ci.internal/runs/12345
Jordan L: looking now. quick skim of the logs shows repeated timeouts in `testdb.apply_seed()` around 30s.
Maya R: this started right after the base-image bump to `redwood/base:py310-2026-03-20`. suspect the DB client upgrade.
Devon P: options: pin base-image to last-green and rerun smoke (fast), or rebuild matrix (slow). change window closes in ~2h.
Kim S: prefer a pin + quick smoke rerun to avoid slipping the release window. if rerun still flakes, we revert and schedule full rerun overnight.
Jordan L: can do pin + rerun. I'll open a tiny pin commit `ci: pin base -> py310-2026-03-10` and trigger a manual promote.
Devon P: I'll prepare rollback checklist (how to revert the pin and re-trigger full matrix) and update release notes accordingly.
SRE_Oncall: noted. if smoke passes but we see DB latency in canary, I'll keep monitoring and ready the rollback playbook.
Kim S: action items: Jordan pushes pin (in progress), Devon writes rollback/notes, Maya files triage ticket to root-cause the client change. promote once smoke rerun is green 2/2.
Jordan L: pinned and pushed: `git commit -m "ci: pin base image to py310-2026-03-10 (temp)"` -> branch `rc/pin-base-1699998888`.
Jordan L: triggered manual promote via deploy-bot. CI run id 12346 queued.
deploy-bot: CI run 12346 smoke: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :shipit:
Kim S: promoting now. release notes draft: "RC 2026.03.23 — temporarily pinned base image to avoid a smoke flake; investigation ticket #5678." will merge and cut.
Maya R: creating ticket #5678 with repro steps, docker diffs, and stack traces. attaching `diffs/py310-2026-03-20_vs_2026-03-10.txt`.
Devon P: adding an entry to changelog and emailing stakeholders: "Temporary pin applied — follow-up investigation in progress." including rollback plan.
Kim S: thanks all. hold cleared and cutting the RC. Follow-up: if ticket #5678 shows client incompatibility we'll schedule a patch and coordinate a re-cut outside the change window.
Jordan L: note — I'll also add a short CI guard to run the seed step with extended timeout in the matrix for a couple cycles to reduce flakiness while we triage.
SRE_Oncall: copied. I'll add an alert for seed failures and set a pager policy to avoid noisy spikes during the rest of the rollout.
